text: Found the plumbing cause of the low bid volume: when Novig answered 'game locked' (a game that has started or is frozen) for ONE bid, the desk treated it as a whole-pass stop and quit, so it posted about 3 of 250 wanted bids each pass while your cash sat idle. Fix: a locked game now only skips that game (for 10 min) and every other bid still goes up. No profit rule is loosened: each bid goes through the same +EV, sharp-book and per-game checks as before, and the ordering (most-likely-to-fill first, proven types first) is unchanged. Logged in CHANGES.md with a revert rule. It ships in the next version together with your list-jump fix (building now); I'll then watch how many bids go up and tell you.
